> Ignore shape geometry. In top-left candidate order, output `8` for candidate

## How the answer was checked

1. The task-local Python parser identifies the color-2 key and candidates in
   top-left order, normalizes each mask, and applies exact-or-horizontal-mirror
   equivalence.
2. `workspace/review_probe.py` records the exact grid, all rival outputs, and
   the oracle output in
   `checks/after-probe/review_probe_seed91_hard.json`.
3. The canonical Racket program was applied independently to the same grid. Its
   output exactly equals `[[8,0,8,0]]`; the receipt is
   `checks/after-probe/racket_exact_receipt.json`.
4. The official semantic gate repeated this comparison over 600 generated
   inputs and verified all four witness/rival claims without an oracle error.

## Does the generator emit such cases?

Yes, deliberately and frequently. Every fourth example uses the
`canonical_color_conflict` profile. It preserves the canonical `9×16`, six-
color, four-candidate, two-positive morphology while permuting color roles and
reading order so the canonical shortcut is false. In the official 600-draw
semantic census, the `color_role_conflict` witness fired 289 times across all
three difficulty bands. The strict canonical profile appeared 16 times in the
60-draw profile gate, with support in every band.
